title: Updating documents
summary: Change existing documents with updateOne, updateMany, $set, $inc, $unset and $push.

quiz.q: Three students live in Salem. What does `db.students.updateOne({ city: 'Salem' }, { $inc: { marks: 1 } })` do?
options: Adds 1 mark to the first matching student only
Adds 1 mark to a random student
quiz.explain: `updateOne` stops after the first match. Use `updateMany` to change all three.

quiz.q: Complete the operator that adds 10 to the current stock.
quiz.explain: `$inc` adds a number to the existing value, so it does not need you to read the old value first.

quiz.q: A student has `marks: 60`. After this update runs, what are the marks? Type the number.
quiz.explain: A negative number with `$inc` subtracts. 60 minus 10 is 50.

options: The whole document is replaced by { marks: 100 }
MongoDB reports an error because the update has no operator such as $set
Nothing happens and no error appears
quiz.explain: `updateOne` and `updateMany` require update operators. Write `{ $set: { marks: 100 } }`. Replacing a whole document is done by a different method, `replaceOne`.

quiz.q: Arrange the pieces to add the badge 'topper' to Asha.
quiz.explain: First the method, then the filter that picks the document, then the update, then the closing bracket.

exercise.task:
Write four update statements for the `students` collection:

- Set Bala's `city` to `'Chennai'`.
- Give every student in the `'CSE'` department 5 more `marks`.
- Add the badge `'topper'` to Asha's `badges` array.
- Remove the `phone` field from Chitra.

Pick the filters carefully so that nobody else changes.
hints: Each change is its own `updateOne` or `updateMany` call. Only the CSE change affects several students.
Use `$set`, `$inc`, `$push` and `$unset` in that order. A filter like `{ name: 'Bala' }` picks one student.

db.students.updateOne({ name: 'Bala' }, { $set: { city: 'Chennai' } })
db.students.updateMany({ dept: 'CSE' }, { $inc: { marks: 5 } })
db.students.updateOne({ name: 'Asha' }, { $push: { badges: 'topper' } })
db.students.updateOne({ name: 'Chitra' }, { $unset: { phone: '' } })
